parameters.name: mu_acc_n_zhao2007
parameters.citation: P. Zhao, Rusli, C. L. Zhu, J. H. Xia, DC characterization of accumulation layer and bulk layer electron mobility in 4H-SiC depletion mode MOSFET, Solid-State Electronics 51, 1139-1143 (2007)
parameters.locator: p. 1141, Sec. 3 text ('mu_s = 17.5 +/- 0.1 cm2/V s', fit over 7.0 V < V_GS < 10.0 V, V_DS 50-200 mV); the abstract (p. 1139) notes about 17.5 cm2/V s was previously deduced (their ref. [17]) and p. 1141 re-derives it
parameters.validity: Average accumulation-layer electron mobility of a Si-face 4H-SiC depletion-mode MOSFET, n-channel N_D = 2.4e17 cm^-3 (SIMS, p. 1140), thermal gate oxide WITHOUT nitridation (abstract p. 1139; p. 1142), C_ox = 6.9e-4 F/m^2 and W/L = 40/3 um (p. 1141), room temperature (numeric temperature not stated), extracted from the slopes of I_DS vs V_GS (V_DS 50-200 mV) with the lumped accumulation-plus-bulk-channel model of Eq. (1), valid in strong accumulation; the paper treats it as an average over V_GS > 7 V (Fig. 4 shows about 19 -> 16 cm^2/Vs over V_GS 7-11 V). Used in widegap stage 18 ONLY as the pessimistic end of a bracket for the JFET accumulation surface; not representative of NO-nitrided oxide; no field or N_S dependence given.
